semanticFindings.finding: Existing committed-media recovery still requires matching complete journal/DB image identity, regular private path and size, full SHA256, current type/frame/completeness/dimension policy, exact width/height/MIME tuple, and final file signature. Only the already validated bitmap decode is omitted. Original screenshots, private bytes and durable records are not deleted or rewritten to achieve the speedup.

First import and uncommitted journal/media/staging recovery retain default full inspect including the ImageIO thumbnail request before adoption. Existing used-history handling is unchanged; this increment does not newly certify or rehash every used record.

QueueStore, TransferCoordinator, receipt policy, adapter and page code bindings are byte-identical. UNKNOWN remains preserved; recovering a private file is not a new upload, retry authority, START or final completion. Consumer START and no-automatic-resend wording remains accurate.

CaptureService, CaptureSourceBinding, App source and entry control bindings are unchanged. The optimization does not import the whole source directory, broaden screenshot eligibility, change pause/hide semantics or create a new permission gate.

Feedback owners, diagnostics, storage recovery and release tool bindings are unchanged. Existing network consent/outbox continuation, full backup, App-only update and no destructive database rollback guidance remains accurate.

Actual isolated native corpus measurements support reduced recovery work. They do not establish a full App visible launch SLA, current real ChatGPT acceptance or universal image-decoder rejection behavior; no such claim is added to consumer guides.
